verdict.rationale: CockroachDB's docs describe full and incremental backups, and a restore to an arbitrary point in time within a backup's revision history. That covers the core point-in-time recovery from bad writes. Community comments say backup/restore was historically gated behind enterprise licensing, which is a licensing caveat rather than evidence the capability fails. Missing for 10: any evidence of branching/forking the database to a point in time, detail on how the retention window is configured and its limits, and hands-on or independent corroboration of point-in-time restore.
